mapper.insert: /* QA선정 관리 (7060) */ /* AdminQaTargetMapper.insert */ MERGE INTO CSPD107TI A USING DUAL ON (A.AI_INPT_IMEX_DSCD = #{aiInptImexDscd}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.QLAS_ITM_TOT_CNT = #{qlasItmTotCnt}, A.QLAS_VOLN_CHC_CNT = #{qlasVolnChcCnt}, A.AI_INPT_LIST_ID = #{aiInptListId}, A.INPT_SANCTION_NO = #{aiInptItmCd}, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO = #{trnLogSrno} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (A.QLAS_SLT_MNG_ID, A.AI_INPT_IMEX_DSCD, A.QLAS_ITM_TOT_CNT, A.QLAS_VOLN_CHC_CNT, A.QLAS_SLBS_VLD_YN, A.AI_INPT_LIST_ID, A.INPT_SANCTION_NO, A.QLAS_SLT_RGS_DTM, A.QLAS_SLT_END_DTM, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM) VALUES (CSPD107TI_SG01.NEXTVAL, #{aiInptImexDscd}, #{qlasItmTotCnt}, #{qlasVolnChcCnt}, 'Y', #{aiInptListId}, #{aiInptItmCd}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), NULL, #{trnLogSrno}, #{lstDbChgId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))
